category: FSL Civic Observances: Lupang Hinirang (National Anthem)

phrases.label: Bayang magiliw
phrases.instruction: Place your right flat palm against your left chest (heart), then gently open and extend your hand forward with palm facing slightly upward.

phrases.label: Perlas ng Silanganan
phrases.instruction: Pinch thumb and index fingertips together at chest level (pearl), then rise the dominant hand upward from behind the horizontal non-dominant arm (rising sun).

phrases.label: Alab ng puso
phrases.instruction: Touch or point lightly toward your chest (heart), then raise both hands upward with rapidly fluttering fingers (blazing fire).

phrases.label: Sa dibdib mo'y buhay
phrases.instruction: Place your flat palm firmly across the center of your chest and maintain a proud upright posture to signal vitality and life.

phrases.label: Lupang hinirang
phrases.instruction: Gesture toward the ground/land with open palms facing downward, then bring the dominant hand forward in a choosing/cherishing motion.

phrases.label: Duyan ka ng magiting
phrases.instruction: Form a rocking cradle motion with curved forearms, then raise a clenched fist near the shoulder symbolizing bravery.

phrases.label: Sa manlulupig
phrases.instruction: Form clawed or grasping hands pushing downward aggressively to depict an invading or oppressing force.

phrases.label: Di ka pasisiil
phrases.instruction: Cross wrists firmly in front of the chest and shake your head sideways with a resolute facial expression (never yielding).

phrases.label: Sa dagat at bundok
phrases.instruction: Wave an open horizontal hand outward for sea waves, then trace an inverted 'V' peak upward for mountains.

phrases.label: Sa simoy at sa langit
phrases.instruction: Sway open fluttered palms softly across the face level (breeze), then sweep both arms upward toward the sky.

phrases.label: May dilag ang tula at awit
phrases.instruction: Trace along your cheek for beauty/radiance, followed by conduct waves from the mouth symbolizing lyrical song.

phrases.label: Sa paglayang minamahal
phrases.instruction: Cross wrists and break them outward to an open release (freedom), then cross open hands over the chest (cherished/beloved).

phrases.label: Ang kislap ng watawat mo'y
phrases.instruction: Pinch and expand fingers outward near the eyes for gleaming light, then hold an upright non-dominant pole and wave the dominant flat hand like a flag.

phrases.label: Tagumpay na nagniningning
phrases.instruction: Raise both hands into dual 'V' victory formations overhead, expanding fingers outward into shimmering sparkles.

phrases.label: Ang bituin at araw niya
phrases.instruction: Flick index finger pinches across upper corners (stars), then form a circle with thumb and index expanding outward with all fingers (radiant sun).

phrases.label: Kailan pa ma'y 'di magdidilim
phrases.instruction: Extend index finger forward tracing infinite time, shake head firmly 'no', and push hands downward blocking out darkness.

phrases.label: Lupa ng araw ng luwalhati't pagsinta
phrases.instruction: Gesture toward land, expand the high sun, lift arms in glorification, and pull both hands onto the chest in deep love.

phrases.label: Buhay ay langit sa piling mo
phrases.instruction: Touch chest upward for life, open palms upward toward the heavens, and bring hands together in a gentle clasp beside the body.

phrases.label: Aming ligaya
phrases.instruction: Brush flat open palms upward across your chest repeatedly with a cheerful, smiling facial expression (happiness/joy).

phrases.label: Na 'pag may mang-aapi
phrases.instruction: Press down firmly with dominant fist onto the flat palm below with an intense, watchful facial expression.

phrases.label: Ang mamatay
phrases.instruction: Turn both open hands simultaneously so that the dominant palm flips downward while the non-dominant flips upward (transition of life/death).

phrases.label: Nang dahil sa'yo
phrases.instruction: Point open hand forward outward with reverent eye contact, acknowledging devotion to the nation.
